testResults.name: cross-timeframe-run
testResults.result: 1514 sessions joined; regime lift tables and regime-conditional shape profiles written to cross_timeframe.json; 0DTE lake overlay (42 sessions) at zero_dte_overlay.parquet

limitations: Shape-space cluster null: real DBCV equals all surrogate families, so the pooled test cannot detect time-of-day phase organization; the conditional within-vol-quintile test (next steps) is required before concluding on the phase hypothesis
Phase-randomized surrogates preserve the wavelet-variance fingerprint by construction, so only time-localized features are testable against that null
Open-block D3/D4 block energies are structurally dead under the causal reflection boundary (L_j-1 trim zone); open-window claims require the Morlet CWT route
Surrogate reps at 12 per family give coarse null distributions; 50 reps recommended before treating the null verdict as definitive

Two pre-existing ruff F841 violations in classification_accuracy.py and strategy_backtests.py and four pre-existing ty diagnostics in tests/harness/cli/test_supervisor.py and tests/thesis/integrations/test_activation.py are integration findings from other sessions' uncommitted work, not this wave
